definition: A coherent grouping of styles that share one generative logic, such as English Classical. A family carries a kit of its own: the shared base on which every style filed under it builds.
basis: schema/style-node.schema.json, on the rank: "family = coherent grouping sharing a generative logic". docs/model.md gives the example: "A grouping sharing a generative logic | English Classical". README.md keeps a kit "One file per style, variant, *and* family", and build/build.py puts a style's own family at the head of its kit cascade as the "shared base a style extends against".
